prior_year_events.impact_description: Strengthening of reserves and increases in booked ultimates for exposures related to war on land and contingent aviation war/hull cover; reserve setting moved to case-by-case basis and includes associated legal fees.

named_events.loss_description: Booked ultimates gross $230.6m (2023: $64.9m) and net $76.4m (2023: $27.3m); reserve setting now case-by-case and includes legal fees.
The largest catastrophe loss in the Syndicate in the 2024 calendar year; sensitivity testing noted a 25% deterioration on Milton would lead to material increases.
Natural catastrophe claims were broadly in line with expectations, with the Syndicate incurring losses on Hurricanes Helene and Milton.
Large event mentioned among significant 2024 losses impacting the combined operating ratio.
Post balance sheet event: estimated final net range for this loss is $53.3m to $71.5m (inclusive of inwards and outwards reinstatement premiums).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were $600.4m. During 2024 gross claims outstanding increased materially to $1,009.6m at year end driven by claims incurred, inclusion of a RITC from Syndicate 3268, and reserve strengthening for exposures to the Russia-Ukraine conflict. Natural catastrophe activity (notably Hurricanes Helene and Milton) and several large losses (including Baltimore Bridge) also influenced reserve development. The presence of an RITC and portfolio acquisitions has distorted development tables which limits the ability to calculate a single, reliable prior-year gross movement from the available disclosures.
raw_causal_phrases: Natural catastrophe claims incurred by the Syndicate were broadly in line with expectations, with the Syndicate incurring losses on Hurricanes Helene and Milton.

The booked ultimates for these losses as at 31 December 2024 are$230.6m (2023*: $64.9m) gross of reinsurance and $76.4m (2023*: $27.3m) net of reinsurance (inclusive of inwards and outwards reinstatement premiums).
The total gross estimate for incurred but not reported ("IBNR") losses as at 31 December 2024 is $763.2m (2023*: $419.8m).
The Syndicate has material exposure to Hurricanes Milton and Helene.
strengthening of reserves for the Russia-Ukraine Conflict
In 2024 the reserve setting has also taken into consideration the associated legal fees.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and Other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding prior year column). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' amount is disclosed. Claims development triangle and technical provision reconciliation are both impacted by a RITC (Syndicate 3268) and by portfolio transfers which distort year-on-year comparisons; therefore a reliable aggregate gross prior-year development figure could not be calculated from available disclosures. Some cause/LOB mappings are inferred from narrative rather than quantified by LOB.
